$comment: Independent reviewed manifest of approved public configuration (RETURN-4 P1-4). The gates verify environment values AGAINST this manifest instead of trusting the same variables that built the bundle. Origins are compared exactly (scheme, hostname, port) after parsing — never by string prefix. The development profile approves only the local loopback stack origin and requires the current publishable key shape; candidate is the authorized synthetic lane carrying the development configuration by design; release approvals are absent on purpose (HOLD) and a custom Supabase domain may be added only as an explicit exact origin here after review.

development.notes: Local loopback Supabase stack only; synthetic data only. 10.0.2.2 is the Android emulator's alias for the HOST's loopback: the same stack, named as the emulator must name it, not a second destination. Cleartext to it is permitted by plugins/with-android-debug-loopback.js in DEBUG builds only. Candidate and release are deliberately not given this origin.

candidate.notes: Authorized SYNTHETIC candidate lane: production-mode export with development configuration; never a functional production build.

release.notes: HOLD: no production configuration is approved. Kody adds the exact origin and exact publishable key here upon approval.
